title: Minimum dimensions.
officialText:
Piles shall have a nominal outside diameter of not less than 8 inches (203 mm) and a minimum
wall thickness in accordance with Section 1809.3.4. For mandrel-driven pipe piles, the minimum wall thickness shall be
1/ inch (2.5 mm).
10
